candidate_rules.DEPTH_15_30_RECOVERY_05_15: 15%-30% maximum depth and 5%-15% recovery from the signal-known 20-session low

economic_hypothesis: A first causal MA5 reclaim below a low-occupancy true gap is most useful after a meaningful but non-destructive washout. Shallow declines are noise, while extreme declines may represent unresolved structural damage.

execution.collision_low_occupancy_rank: pre_gap_inside_touch_sessions / 120; lower first; causal daily proxy used because the broader direct population has no minute-VAP field
execution.entry: first legal buyable 1-minute open strictly after signal close
execution.time_stop: H20 then next legal sellable 1-minute open

post_2023_scope: trade management/completion only; no post-2023 signal or selection

source_population.base_reversal: first MA5 reclaim with recent low age 2-10 and recovery from low >=3%
source_population.source: V4R1 direct_first_ma5_candidates, before VAP and pre-gap-return filtering
